chat.say: Pankha band kar aur geyser on kar de jaldi.
Subah nahane ka plan ab seedhe March mein.

data.asar: Subah uthne ke liye 5 extra alarm lagane padenge.
data.caption:
Bhai ab sach mein rajai se nikalne ka mann nahi karega! 🥶❄️

- 13 rajyon mein ghana kohra chhaane ka alert jaari hua hai.
- Srinagar mein mausam ki sabse thandi raat darj ki gayi.
- Rajasthan aur MP mein sheetlahar shuru ho chuki hai.
- Jharkhand aur Bihar samet pure North India mein thithuran badh gayi hai.

Subah-subah thande paani se nahane wale doston ko shat-shat naman! 😂

Comment mein batao: Aapke shahar ka taapmaan kitna gir chuka hai?
